% Pattern: head/case. A command of one argument writes it in bold with a
% period, \nc{\p}[1]{\bigskip\noindent\textbf{#1.}}, where \nc is
% \newcommand, and a proof writes its steps and cases with it. Seen in the
% gold pilot (set X).
% want theorem-1 statement/theorem 1
% want proof-1 proof - proves=theorem-1
% want head-1 other/case 1
% want head-2 other/case 2
\documentclass{article}
\newcommand{\nc}{\newcommand}
\nc{\p}[1]{\bigskip\noindent\textbf{#1.}}
\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}
\begin{document}
\begin{theorem} Every compact space is bounded. \end{theorem}
\begin{proof}
\p{Step 1: a cover} Take a cover of the space by balls.

\p{Step 2: a finite part} Take a finite part of the cover.
\end{proof}
\end{document}
